name: CalibrationWidenedWall
description: The same plate with one side wall pushed 1 mm outward instead of its top face lifted. The second reading on `move_face`, and it is a different question rather than a second helping of the first: the top face is what a cap-and-distance mistake would still get right, while a side wall is picked out of four by a selector and moved along an axis that is not the extrude's own. True answer 40 x 6 x 1 mm = 0.24 cm^3, exact for the same reason as its partner. Two things could make a live run disagree here while `lifted_face` passes -- the selector reaching a different face on Inventor than in the simulator, and a direction argument Inventor reads relative to the face rather than to the model -- and a run that agrees on both fixtures has ruled out both. The volume is deliberately small next to the plate it sits on, so a move that quietly took the whole wall with it is a large fraction rather than a rounding error.
